title: Whole Turkey (frozen)

drivers.name: Thanksgiving (holiday)
drivers.evidence: Past 3 event weeks: median x28.13 vs baseline, noise-adjusted x16.16; 2025: x22.82, 2024: x33.44

drivers.name: Store closed Monday
drivers.evidence: One weekday lost; no compensation; historical impact of store closures on weekly sales is ~10-20% in frozen meat

adjustment.analysis: The Thanksgiving holiday is the dominant driver, with strong historical evidence: past event weeks show median x28.13 vs baseline, noise-adjusted x16.16. The classical uplift model reflects this well. However, the store closure on Monday reduces demand, likely cutting sales by ~15% (one weekday lost, no compensation). The price is unchanged, so no lift or drag. Past promotions are irrelevant here (no discount). The baseline already captures trend and seasonality. Shrink the uplift slightly due to one past occurrence (2025) and store closure risk. Median multiplier adjusted down from 16.16 to 14.0. Downside spread widened slightly to 1.2 due to closure uncertainty.
